name: What is the typical cost to build a backyard guest house in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to build a backyard guest house in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a backyard guest house in Los Angeles varies significantly based on size, complexity, materials, and finishes. Smaller, more basic units might start around $150,000 to $250,000, while larger, custom, and luxury builds with high-end finishes can easily exceed $400,000. This includes design, permits, site preparation, construction, and utility connections. Engaging with a builder for a detailed quote is essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a backyard guest house in Los Angeles range from $150,000 for basic units to over $400,000 for luxury builds, depending on size, materials, and complexity.
